cross_season.note: Gap 1, not attempted. PrestoSports reissues every player id AND every team id each season, so no id-based signal survives a season boundary and team continuity is unavailable as a corroborating signal. person_id is WITHIN-SEASON only.

cross_team_within_season.note: A person who changed teams mid-season gets one person_id per team. Not linked here: the key is (season, team_id, name), and no evidence in the identity table separates a mid-season move from two different people with the same name on two rosters.

meta.scope: WITHIN-SEASON identity, keyed on (season, team_id, name). A real player_id is its own person_id; only synthetic syn:<side>:<n> ids are resolved here, because those are per-GAME positional and are reused by different people across games.
